disagreements.verifier: Whether the same-as link is cited as evidence by where. holds' visibility rule says 'The links relied on are not added to the evidence (ID-D §3.10)', but the where contract (WH-17, evidence table) is silent. Reading 1: sa-crate must not be cited (treat as not reported). Reading 2: it may be cited as supporting since the answer rests on the identity. Gold lists it admissible-not-required so neither reading fails.
As F-002: whether the same-as link sa-crate is cited by where (holds says relied-on links are not added to evidence; where is silent). Gold lists it admissible, not required.

§0.12 (where): 'A derived candidate from a position disputed by an accepted denial is not INFERRED: the answer is not an undisputed INFERRED.' This excludes INFERRED but does not fix the status. Reading 1: the polarity-disputed statement yields a DISPUTED candidate and the answer is DISPUTED (WH-9 'verified DISPUTED candidate'; v0.2 5.3; common 0.7 'The answer must then be DISPUTED'). Reading 2: a polarity-disputed statement does not 'hold for the perspective at t' (candidates row), so there is no candidate and WH-11 gives UNKNOWN (records visible). Gold takes reading 1.
Same passage and readings as F-010 (§0.12 where row fixes only 'not an undisputed INFERRED'; DISPUTED versus no candidate / UNKNOWN). Gold takes DISPUTED.

SD-SPA-4: 'compatible only when every pair of positioned, verified candidates was compared and overlaps'. Reading 1 (gold): all candidates must be positioned and pairwise compared; one candidate is unpositioned, so not every pair was compared: judgement None. Reading 2 (literal): only one candidate is positioned and verified, so the set of such pairs is empty and the condition holds vacuously: 'compatible'. Reading 2 would label a DISPUTED answer compatible, which the gold rejects. Also: the role of pos-lens-arm (position_support of a candidate with x None) is not fixed by the where evidence table.
Minor: evidence sets are per question but the steps are in different worlds; fix-pump is admissible only for s2 and stip-pump only for s1, which the single per-question sets cannot express.

Possible tension: §0.12 'No reader reports content that is DISPUTED for the perspective as undisputed', while poses/facts_about judge the (positioned, frame) slot at the default 1e-9 rad (PO-3) and would mark these two orientations DISPUTED. Reading 1 (gold): WH-8 and SD-SPA-1 make angle_tolerance a per-question policy that decides orientation conflicts in where, so ASSERTED/compatible. Reading 2: the slot is disputed at the default tolerance regardless of the question policy, so where must stay DISPUTED. Gold follows WH-8, which is the specific rule.
